Capt Sam Bruch  Wash'n Mar 1st 1865
Growl Plug Florence for Palsy Rhabe hunt All in chief
Vintan Dolphin zebra Shelby Pekin Pandora Saw till expects harsh
promise animals with the whiff from Lady to Eddy and
that plaster waldo will stop at girls with the Pacific
unity He estimates for Shaker for Leg person Purple through
Emmet zodiac Lamb wrangles me that he has sent plaster
promise and person publish animals to guns and pebble Woodbury
to Eddy Pedlar no more zodiac I fear that he
has omitted to note Plug promise with the nuptial zebra
Regulate supplies accordingly unity The increase appears to be Padlock
Waldo Plaster Prolong instead of harrow person purple yoke Belcher


SH Becksmith  Washn Mch 2d 1865 
Clotilda Hawkins Negus You dresden sent contents of
Whack papers for Raymond or Stanton black Did you not
hamper them Copper If not does it indicate anything
Include Milk


to Beckwith  Nashville Mch 1st 65
2 pm for Lt Gen Grant Your telegram of
1030 am today recvd . will 
send your order to Genl Wilson
